properties.name: security.jwt.secret-key
properties.description: A secure 256-bit key for signing JWT tokens.

properties.name: security.jwt.expiration-time
properties.description: Expiration time for access tokens in milliseconds.

properties.name: security.jwt.refresh-expiration-time
properties.description: Expiration time for refresh tokens in milliseconds.

properties.name: kafka.backoff.initialInterval
properties.description: Initial delay before the first retry in milliseconds for Kafka consumer.

properties.name: kafka.backoff.multiplier
properties.description: Multiplication factor for each subsequent retry delay.

properties.name: kafka.backoff.maxInterval
properties.description: Maximum wait interval between retries in milliseconds.

properties.name: kafka.backoff.maxElapsedTime
properties.description: Maximum total elapsed time to retry before sending message to DLQ in milliseconds.

properties.name: outbox.scheduler.delay
properties.description: Polling delay in milliseconds for processing pending outbox events.
